title: The Rocket - From East to West

sentences.en: A The concept of the rocket, or rather the mechanism behind the idea of propelling an object into the air, has been around for well over two thousand years.
sentences.zh: 火箭的概念,或者说把物体推进空中的构想背后的机制,已经存在了两千年多。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: However, it wasn’t until the discovery of the reaction principle, which was the key to space travel and so represents one of the great milestones in the history of scientific thought that rocket technology was able to develop.
sentences.zh: 这也是太空旅行的关键, 也是科学史上关于火箭技术能够发展的重要里程碑之一。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构

sentences.en: Not only did it solve a problem that had intrigued man for ages, but, more importantly, it literally opened the door to exploration of the universe.
sentences.zh: 它不仅解决了一个问题人类已经吸引了很长时间, 而且,更重要的是, 它实际上打开了探索宇宙的大门。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: B An intellectual breakthrough, brilliant though it may be, does not automatically ensure that the transition is made from theory to practice.
sentences.zh: B类知识突破虽然可能很出色,但并不能自动确保从理论向实践过渡。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that rockets had been used sporadically for several hundred years, they remained a relatively minor artefact of civilisation until the twentieth century.
sentences.zh: 尽管火箭在几百年中一直偶尔使用,但直到二十世纪,火箭仍然是文明中相对较小的一面。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Prodigious efforts, accelerated during two world wars, were required before the technology of primitive rocketry could be translated into the reality of sophisticated astronauts.
sentences.zh: 在两次世界大战期间加速了巨大的努力,在原始火箭技术能够转化为尖端宇航员的现实之前,需要这种努力。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: It is strange that the rocket was generally ignored by writers of fiction to transport their heroes to mysterious realms beyond the Earth, even though it had been commonly used in fireworks displays in China since the thirteenth century.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是,尽管自十三世纪以来中国的烟火展示中经常使用火箭,但那些编剧却普遍忽视了火箭,把英雄运到地球以外的神秘领域。

sentences.en: The reason is that nobody associated the reaction principle with the idea of travelling through space to a neighbouring world.
sentences.zh: 原因是没有人将反应原则与穿越空间前往邻国世界的想法联系起来。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: C A simple analogy can help us to understand how a rocket operates.
sentences.zh: C 简单类比可以帮助我们了解火箭是如何运作的。

sentences.en: It is much like a machine gun mounted on the rear of a boat.

sentences.en: The reaction to the ejection of these small particles causes the rocket to move forwards.

sentences.en: There is evidence that the reaction principle was applied practically well before the rocket was invented.

sentences.zh: 亚卢斯·盖利乌斯在《新爱之夜》或《希腊之夜》中描述“Archytas之鸽”,

sentences.en: By the thirteenth century, powder-propelled fire arrows had become rather common.

sentences.en: The Chinese relied on this type of technological development to produce incendiary projectiles of many sorts, explosive grenades and possibly cannons to repel their enemies.
sentences.zh: 中国人依靠这种技术发展生产各种燃烧弹、爆炸性手榴弹和可能用来击退敌人的炮。

sentences.en: One such weapon was the ‘basket of fire’ or, as directly translated from Chinese, the ‘arrows like flying leopards’.

sentences.en: The 0.7 metre-long arrows, each with a long tube of gunpowder attached near the point of each arrow, could be fired from a long, octagonal-shaped basket at the same time and had a range of 400 paces.
sentences.zh: 0.7米长的箭头,每支箭头附近有长管火药,可同时从长长的八角形篮子射出,射程400步。

sentences.en: Another weapon was the ‘arrow as a flying sabre’, which could be fired from crossbows.

sentences.en: E It was not until the eighteenth century that Europe became seriously interested in the possibilities of using the rocket itself as a weapon of war and not just to propel other weapons.
sentences.zh: 直到十八世纪,欧洲才开始认真关注能否将火箭本身用作战争武器,而不仅仅是推进其他武器。

sentences.en: The incentive for the more aggressive use of rockets came not from within the European continent but from far-away India, whose leaders had built up a corps of rocketeers and used rockets successfully against the British in the late eighteenth century.
sentences.zh: 更积极使用火箭的动机不是来自欧洲大陆内部,而是来自遥远的印度,印度领导人在十八世纪末建立了一支火箭炮部队,成功地对英国使用了火箭。

sentences.en: The Indian rockets used against the British were described by a British Captain serving in India as ‘an iron envelope about 200 millimetres long and 40 millimetres in diameter with sharp points at the top and a 3m-long bamboo guiding stick’.
sentences.zh: 印度对英国人使用的火箭被一名英国船长描述为“印度的铁封,直径约200毫米,直径约40毫米,顶部尖尖,竹制导杆3米长”。

sentences.en: In the early nineteenth century the British began to experiment with incendiary barrage rockets.

sentences.en: The British rocket differed from the Indian version in that it was completely encased in a stout, iron cylinder, terminating in a conical head, measuring one metre in diameter and having a stick almost five metres long and constructed in such a way that it could be firmly attached to the body of the rocket.
sentences.zh: 英国火箭与印度的版本不同,因为它完全被封在一个铁柱铁柱中,以圆锥头结束,直径测量一米,一根树枝长度近五米,其构造方式可以牢固地附在火箭的身上。
